title: Relaypad: Remote Play & Pad
shortDescription: No ads, no subscription. PS5 & PS4 controller, console streaming and TV output.
requires: Requires a PS5 or PS4 console with Remote Play turned on in its settings.
tagline: Relaypad turns your Android phone into a wireless controller for your console, or streams the console picture to your phone, tablet or TV, at home or away.

sections.title: Remote Play Controller and Console Streaming for PS5 and PS4
paragraphs: Relaypad turns your Android phone into a wireless controller for your console, or streams the console picture to your phone, tablet or TV, at home or away.

sections.title: What People Use Relaypad For
bullets: Playing when the controller battery just died
Browsing console menus and video apps with big remote keys
Playing in bed or another room while the console stays by the TV
Putting the picture on a hotel TV over HDMI, with the phone as the pad

sections.title: Virtual Gamepad, Layout Editor and Button Mapping
bullets: Five layouts: Standard, Compact, Remote, Fighting and Racing
Drag, resize or hide any button, and use your own layouts while streaming
Touchpad, rumble, microphone and gyro motion controls
Forward a Bluetooth or USB gamepad with automatic button mapping
USB pads while streaming: adaptive triggers, light bar and haptics

sections.title: Console Streaming up to 1080p60 with HEVC and HDR
bullets: 30 or 60 fps up to 1080p, manual bitrate, HEVC and HDR on supported phones
FSR sharpening and an overlay with fps, packet loss and total latency
TV output over HDMI, picture-in-picture, split layout on tablets and foldables
Minimal mode, Fit, Stretch or Zoom scaling, auto reconnect on home Wi-Fi
Data saver drops to 720p/30fps on mobile data

sections.title: Remote Play Away From Home over Mobile Data
bullets: Sign in once, then connect over 5G, 4G or another Wi-Fi, usually with no router setup
Automatic UPnP port mapping, and home VPNs such as Tailscale work too
Tells you when your carrier's shared address (CGNAT) blocks the connection

sections.title: Connection Doctor: Find Out Why It Won't Connect
bullets: 13 checks: network, console standby, Remote Play switch, latency and jitter
Wi-Fi band, VPN, Bluetooth interference, UPnP, NAT type and public IPv4
Copy the report or email it to us with one tap

sections.title: Guided Setup in Four Steps
bullets: Sign in inside the app or in your browser (passkeys work), or type your account ID
PS5: register without a PIN, even in rest mode; or pair with the 8-digit code
Save several consoles and accounts, rename or re-pair any time

sections.title: No Ads, No Subscription
paragraphs: Relaypad shows no ads and has no subscription. Reinstall it on a new phone with the same Google account at no extra cost. If it does not work with your setup, email us within 7 days of purchase for a refund.

sections.title: Privacy
paragraphs: No Relaypad account and no Relaypad server between you and your console. Pairing keys and sign-in tokens stay on your device, encrypted with the Android Keystore. Anonymous statistics can be turned off.

sections.title: Before You Buy
bullets: You need your own console; no games or cloud gaming are included
Android 8.0 or later; 4 GB of RAM and 5 GHz Wi-Fi recommended
Your phone takes the place of a controller rather than playing alongside one
After a console system update, Relaypad may need an update to connect again

sections.title: Something Not Working? Email Us
paragraphs: Before leaving a review, write to feedback@dapplebyte.com, or use Settings → About → Send feedback to include your phone model automatically. We read every message.

sections.title: Trademark Notice

It works only with hardware and content you own, and does not circumvent copy protection or enable piracy.
